name: How is the performance of generative engine optimization measured?

mainEntity.name: How is the performance of generative engine optimization measured?

acceptedAnswer.text: The performance of Generative Engine Optimization is typically measured through several key metrics. These include improvements in search engine rankings for target keywords, increases in organic website traffic, and the number of qualified leads generated through website forms, phone calls, or direct bookings. Other important indicators are enhanced local search visibility, higher engagement rates on content, and ultimately, a positive return on investment through new customer acquisition. Regular reporting and analysis track these metrics to demonstrate the effectiveness of the GEO strategy.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO performance is measured by search rankings, organic website traffic, qualified leads, local visibility, content engagement, and overall return on investment.
